title: Ate Gay placed on life support after septic shock, stroke

blocks.text: Comedian Gil Aducal Morales, better known as Ate Gay, remains in critical condition and continues to depend on life support after suffering septic shock, acute respiratory failure caused by pneumonia, and a stroke. His family provided an update on his condition in a statement posted on his Facebook page on Friday, Oct. 30, while renewing their appeal for financial assistance. The family disclosed that Morales — who has been diagnosed with mucoepidermoid squamous cell carcinoma, a rare type of cancer — was rushed to the Asian Hospital and Medical Center (AHMC) last Oct. 17 after he experienced difficulty breathing.
